item.title: Rock Springs Police Department Announces K-9 Retirement
item.description: ROCK SPRINGS — The Rock Springs Police Department has announced K-9 Leo has officially retired after seven years of service to the community. Leo’s story as the ultimate underdog started in 2018 when he was brought to Rock Springs Animal Control as an eight week old abandoned puppy by then Animal Control Officer Kim Brown.
